description: Real chargen identity and initial action/learning state for all six Psion disciplines.
prerequisites: A disposable real-game fixture with Psion installed and six distinct legal character-creation flows.
Independent installed class, PP and power-learning table oracles; Intelligence and campaign-start level recorded per actor.
instructions: Create each discipline through the real class and specialization choices, then confirm actual actor identity in gameplay.
Open the real innate bar and observe serialized PP, known powers, learning limits and legal choices without invoking initialization helpers as assertions.
Capture the resulting UI and preserve each actor in a private save. This scenario does not replace combat or progression acceptance.
